# loam

loam is the native runtime for Soil components.

## Primary docs

- README: ./README.md
- Architecture: ./docs/architecture.md
- Install: ./docs/install.md
- Releases: ./docs/releases.md
- Testing: ./docs/testing.md
- Editing: ./docs/edit.md
- Plugin build: scripts/build-mcp-plugin.sh
- WIT contracts: ./wit/README.md
- Agent instructions: ./AGENTS.md

## One-sentence model

Wasmtime runs components; loam links core capabilities, command packages, and
signed plugins; Soil is the language and userland.

## Do not confuse

- soil: language, tools, Spores
- loam: native host runtime
- wasi: WebAssembly system interfaces
- wasi:webgpu: GPU contract
- soil:surface: frame/input handoff
